title: "Cars interactivo"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-tools: true
    df-print: paged
---

```{r}
# Paquetes (descomentar si faltan)
# install.packages(c("dplyr","plotly","DT","crosstalk"))

library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

cars <- as_tibble(datasets::cars) |>
  mutate(velocidad = speed, distancia = dist)

sd <- SharedData$new(cars)
```

# Controles

```{r}
filter_slider("f_speed", "Velocidad", sd, ~velocidad, step = 1)
filter_slider("f_dist",  "Distancia", sd, ~distancia, step = 5)
filter_checkbox("f_bins", "Rango de distancia",
                sd, ~cut(distancia, breaks = c(0,25,50,75,120)),
                inline = TRUE)
```

# Dispersión interactiva

```{r}
plot_ly(sd,
        x = ~velocidad, y = ~distancia,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        hovertemplate = "Velocidad: %{x}<br>Distancia: %{y}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Velocidad (mph)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Distancia de frenado (ft)"))
```

# Tabla filtrable

```{r}
datatable(sd,
          extensions = "Buttons",
          options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy","csv","excel","print"),
                         pageLength = 10),
          rownames = FALSE)
```

# Resumen dinámico

```{r}
sd$data(withSelection = TRUE) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            vel_prom = round(mean(velocidad),2),
            dist_prom = round(mean(distancia),2)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
